system.description:
I will look for you, I will find you, and I will kill you. —Liam Neeson, Taken Keepers of the old way, hunters are survival experts that specialize in exploiting their enemies' weaknesses.

The hunter is a low defense, high-crit striker. They can be built for Melee or Ranged positions.

  • Action: Attack
  • Move: Midline/Backline
  • Key Stat: Awareness
  • Complexity: HHIII
  • Training: Melee, Ranged, Survival

Trainings at Level 1: the Class's Trainings, plus a number of additional Trainings equal to half your Reason (round up).

features.name: Hunter's Mark
features.description:
You can choose a Target when you attack it or by skipping your Move, declaring it as your Mark until you declare a new Mark. The following rules apply while you have a Mark:

  • Your attacks against it with Weapons that have the Keen or Vicious property also have the other property, and Crit if a Bonus causes the result to exceed your Crit range.
  • You roll two d20s on Checks to track it, and use the higher result.

features.name: Survivalist
features.description: You gain a Perk with Survival Training as a Prerequisite, ignoring other prerequisites for it. Further, you have Favor on Checks to track, navigate, and against extreme temperatures, and you can Forage at a Normal Travel Pace.

features.name: Rover
features.description:
Difficult Terrain doesn't impede your walking Speed, and you have Climb and Swim.

Further, you have a 5' bonus to Speed, which increases by 5' every 4 Levels hereafter.

Hunter: 2nd, 6th, 10th Level.

features.name: Lethal Precision
features.description:
When damage is dealt to your Mark by you or an Ally on your Turn, the Mark takes 1 extra damage. This extra damage increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

Hunter: 4th, 8th Level.

features.name: Killer Instinct
features.description: You can sense Beings within Far as if by Blindsight if they are missing any HP or are your Mark.

features.name: Apex Predator
features.description: Your Mark is Weak to your attacks.
